decisions.choice: Use one feature pack for the Syntax transcript hardening work
decisions.rationale: The gaps are connected workflow issues and should compound the existing Planning OS instead of creating parallel truth surfaces.

decisions.choice: Keep the first import-boundary check advisory by default
decisions.rationale: Agents need visibility into drift before the repo adds a brittle blocking gate.

decisions.choice: Keep Zod and the current sync/signaling wire shapes
decisions.rationale: The gap is missing schema-first coverage at boundaries, not a validation-library or protocol migration.

decisions.choice: Keep Coop's token-backed plain CSS system
decisions.rationale: The repo already has design tokens and reusable extension primitives; adding a UI framework would widen the surface without solving the identified gap.

decisions.choice: Keep import-boundary enforcement broad enough to include source and tests
decisions.rationale: An advisory check only helps agent flow when it catches the common places agents introduce shared deep imports, including package-level tests and multiline imports.
